title: Associated-graded bound for coherent cohomology of exceptional thickenings
statement: Let $R_0$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $K_0\subseteq R_0$ an ideal, and $S_0=\operatorname{gr}_{K_0}(R_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. There is an integer $d\geq1$, depending only on the degree-preserving unital ring isomorphism class of $S_0$, with this property. For any Noetherian commutative ring $R$ and ideal $K\subseteq R$ admitting $\operatorname{gr}_K(R)\cong S_0$ as graded unital rings, put $X=\operatorname{Bl}_K(\operatorname{Spec}R)$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup], $\mathcal J=K\mathcal O_X$, and $Y_n=V(\mathcal J^n)$ for $n\geq1$, where $V(\mathcal J^n)$ is the closed subscheme with structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X/\mathcal J^n$. Each $Y_n$ is a Noetherian scheme (it has a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings) [pqf-def-locnoeth], and for every coherent $\mathcal O_{Y_n}$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] one has $H^i(Y_n,\mathcal F)=0$ for $i>d$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. One may take $d$ to be the least integer at least $1$ bounding the dimensions of all scheme-theoretic fibres of $\operatorname{Proj}(S_0)\to\operatorname{Spec}((S_0)_0)$ [def-pc-proj, def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]; when this Proj is empty take $d=1$. No completeness or finite Krull dimension assumption on $R$ is required.

source.place: Tag 0GA6 (section-uniform), paragraph defining d(S) and its stated coherent cohomological bound, applied to the proper exceptional thickenings; d is enlarged to max(1,d(S)). Empty Proj is treated as empty, with no inference that K=R.
